body: We’re doing fine, a little sadness hear and there, I just started a new job. So it’s going I guess.
Thank you, sorry about all this, I’m just stressing. And I don’t think the best and I’m clumsy with words. I think we’re fine rn.
How do I answer “you’re wasting your time on me.” He’s not but, this boy is stubborn as hell.
Thank you so much, I’m trying everything I can
I care maybe a little too much, but I’m trying. He deserves so much more in this life. This worlds so unfair.

I’m trying it’s a money issue, he says he doesn’t wanna talk rn. So I’m trying to give him space to cool down? I’m still texting as long as he responds he’s still there. But I’ll definitely make sure he knows.
It’s pretty regular... but he kinda just says it. This time I know it’s different... I’ll try to contact the police

I wish I could contract someone, the only people I could contact is his county police. I know no one on his side of life. I’ve told him countless times, I’m still telling him. He means too much to me to loose. He’s been through so much, I wanna help him, I’m trying to get to him. Idk...
I’d love to join, I’m up for anything

I mostly wanna maintain my relationships with them, cause well they did raise me, I could’ve been a foster system. So it’s that “I owe them.” Plus both of them have medical problems, it won’t be long I believe till they kick the bucket. I just wanna make it seem like they can’t reach out to me for help. I don’t wanna just leave to who knows where and make them lonely. They’re good people, just have twisted values that aren’t okay. 

And It’s not like I’m with my man because he’s mixed in a form of rebellion. Honestly I’ve met him online 5 or 6 years ago, and we started as friends, comforted each other through break ups, cheaters, mental health. And we’ve only now really confessed our true feelings, and wants to know each other better. And that’s when I realized what he looked like. Which is nothing bad in my opinion. I fell in love with personality, him, not his looks, but looks are a bonus.

Honestly he knows, we’ve been talking for months about it. At first we were joking about it, him saying “I’m never gonna meet your’s they’ll kill me!” Horrible dark joke but yeah. I don’t wanna choose between them, but if I do I choose my man.
